basic_cast.name: Basic Cast
basic_cast.desc: Quick wand flick releasing a sparkling bolt of magic.

stupefy.name: Stupefy
stupefy.desc: Stunning spell. Hits target, deals high damage and stuns for 2.0 seconds.

incendio.name: Incendio
incendio.desc: Roaring stream of magical fire. Deals direct blast damage + burns over 4 seconds. Extra critical damage against Inferi.

bombarda.name: Bombarda
bombarda.desc: Detonates a violent concussive shockwave. Deals heavy AOE damage with knockback.

expelliarmus.name: Expelliarmus
expelliarmus.desc: Disarming charm. Knocks back enemy, interrupts casts and reduces enemy attack power by 35%.

protego.name: Protego
protego.desc: Summons a shimmering magical forcefield. Completely deflects projectiles and grants 60% damage reduction.

ultimate.name: Avada Arcana
ultimate.desc: Ultimate forbidden sorcery. Calls forth blinding emerald lightning bolts that disintegrate targets in a wide blast radius.
